label: Thin-existence rival of the existence-to-act contract survives, checked
meaning: Rival test for the existence-to-act contract against its smallest consumer, Round2ExistenceAct.intellectualExerciseRequiresActFromExistence (premises: every intellectual exerciser exists at the world, the existence-to-act contract). With one existing exerciser in act in no respect, the thin-existence rival holds with the other premise and the conclusion fails. Model-witnessed survival only; the interpretation assigns no act at all, which the rival permits but does not require.
